question: Can an offline discriminator identify a state/action where two supplied candidate causal laws predict different successors, charge an explicit travel-plus-intervention cost, and abstain when information or budget is insufficient?
hypothesis: Disagreement-aware probe proposals can be bounded, cost-accounted and deterministic, but this does not identify a hidden causal law or authorize an action. The existing two-witness learned-delta filter cannot prove general transfer.

frozen_design.purpose: STATIC contract only. Two public candidate law tables are deliberately provided to the offline proposer as an oracle-information upper bound, never to a native learner.
frozen_design.cases: Constructed static two-law counterexample: equal successor at [2,2], different successors for the same action at [4,4]. Neither world is stepped.
frozen_design.execution: No live environment, reset, native integration, fitted training, held-science score, runner, workflow dispatch or new seeds. Only self-contained Python stdlib tests.
frozen_design.input_contract: <=16 unique public state/action probe candidates, <=8 distinct fully specified hypotheses, bounded integer costs, candidate travel charge + intervention charge; missing or duplicate candidate predictions rejected.
frozen_design.fixed_cost_unit: One abstract charged unit. Travel and intervention charges are caller-provided, not independently source-certified; only an authorized native source/actor can later certify executable reachability/cost.
frozen_design.selection: For affordable informative candidates, sort by exact rational fraction disagreeing_hypothesis_pairs / (travel_charge + intervention_charge), then more disagreeing pairs, less cost, lexicographic candidate ID.
frozen_design.safety: Always action_authorized=false and scientific_gain_verified=false; proposal is not an actor command or scientific action permission.
frozen_design.split: No TRAIN/VALID/HELD worlds created or accessed; source-free fixtures only.
frozen_design.data_budget: Zero new original-world steps; zero scored independent scientific trials
frozen_design.compute_budget: Stdlib Python local static unit tests only; no runner dispatch
frozen_design.capacity: 16 candidate probes, 8 proposed law tables, 10 abstract charge units, deterministic

controls: Full-information candidate-law oracle: this static helper IS an upper bound, not an eligible learned control
For actual science, independently FIT-trained strongest non-oracle symbolic/Bayesian/native controls required by WSCM-TRANSFER-02
metrics: exact charged_units_if_executed, no actual charge consumed

classification_rules.supported: All seven negative/static unit tests pass against exact committed files; original source actions remain zero. This is an ENGINEERING-only acceptance.
classification_rules.mixed: Core safety assertions pass but some optional static ordering checks fail. No scientific gain.
classification_rules.negative: Informative candidates are unavailable or unaffordable, or static selection fails required controls. Preserve failing fixture.
classification_rules.invalid: Actual external actions, hidden-law leakage, unauthorized runner use, unpinned source, reused scientific seed or post-score threshold changes. Do not replay uncertain trials.

not_frozen_for_science: No independently sourced unfamiliar family or source lease
No proved candidate reachability or trustworthy charge receipt
No frozen TRAIN/VALID/HELD disjoint identities, seeds or fully fitted baseline hyperparameters
No measurable prequential Brier or intervention superiority as yet
later_sci_go_nogo: A separate complete source- and owner-authenticated freeze under WSCM-TRANSFER-02, with equal-info fully fitted controls, preset Brier/charge/retention/compute gates, verified source custody, and separately authorized first use is mandatory.
